builtinTools.name: csv.fetch
builtinTools.description: Stream a CSV URL row-by-row and return a bounded summary (counts + sample). Use this for multi-MB CSV payloads instead of `http.request` + `csv.parse` — memory stays O(sampleRows).

builtinTools.name: csv.filter
builtinTools.description: Filter object-rows by an exact-match `where` map (every entry must match).

builtinTools.name: csv.parse
builtinTools.description: Parse a CSV string into rows. Default `hasHeader: true` returns objects keyed by header.

builtinTools.name: csv.stringify
builtinTools.description: Serialise rows to CSV. Provide `header` for object-rows; omit for array-rows.

builtinTools.name: db.query.read
builtinTools.description: Run a parameterized SELECT against a stored Postgres credential and return bounded rows.

inputExample.sql: select id, email from customers where status = $1

builtinTools.name: db.query.transaction
builtinTools.description: Run a bounded transaction of parameterized Postgres SELECT/DML statements through a stored credential.

statements.sql: update customers set status = $1 where id = $2
select id, status from customers where id = $1

builtinTools.name: db.query.write
builtinTools.description: Run one parameterized INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE against a stored Postgres credential.

inputExample.sql: update customers set status = $1 where id = $2

builtinTools.name: db.schema.describe
builtinTools.description: Describe tables and columns from a stored Postgres credential without running arbitrary SQL.

builtinTools.name: email.send
builtinTools.description: Send a transactional email via the configured mailer (Resend or SendGrid).

builtinTools.name: github.create_issue
builtinTools.description: Create a GitHub issue using a stored PAT credential.

builtinTools.name: http.request
builtinTools.description: Make an HTTP request to an external API.

builtinTools.name: json.merge
builtinTools.description: Deep-merge two objects; `b` wins on key conflicts. Arrays are replaced wholesale.

builtinTools.name: json.parse
builtinTools.description: Parse a JSON string into its native object, array, or primitive value.

builtinTools.name: json.pick
builtinTools.description: Pick a value from workflow context using a dot path.

builtinTools.name: json.set
builtinTools.description: Return a copy of `source` with `value` set at the dotted `path`.

builtinTools.name: pagerduty.incident.acknowledge
builtinTools.description: Acknowledge one PagerDuty incident using a stored API token.

builtinTools.name: pagerduty.incident.get
builtinTools.description: Read one authoritative PagerDuty incident using a stored API token.

builtinTools.name: pagerduty.incident.snooze
builtinTools.description: Snooze one PagerDuty incident for a bounded duration using a stored API token.

builtinTools.name: pagerduty.outcome.verify
builtinTools.description: Verify an authoritative PagerDuty re-read is the same acknowledged incident and retains the exact snooze deadline returned by the write receipt.

builtinTools.name: pagerduty.policy.evaluate
builtinTools.description: Evaluate PagerDuty event type, assignment, finite activation, filters, and event/receipt/action time windows without an LLM.

builtinTools.name: pdf.generate
builtinTools.description: Render a Markdown template to a PDF and store it in the object store.

builtinTools.name: sheet.append
builtinTools.description: Append rows to a named per-organization CSV sheet in the object store. Creates the sheet on first append; later appends keep the sheet's existing columns. Appends to the same sheet are serialized across Janusly replicas.

builtinTools.name: slack.post
builtinTools.description: Send a message to a Slack channel via a stored Incoming Webhook URL.

builtinTools.name: text.uppercase
builtinTools.description: Uppercase a text value.

builtinTools.name: time.now
builtinTools.description: Return the current UTC instant for an explicit action-time policy check.

builtinTools.name: time.window
builtinTools.description: Check whether an instant falls inside recurring local time windows (e.g. business hours) in an IANA time zone. `days` uses 0=Sunday..6=Saturday; `start`/`end` are 24h `HH:MM` local times and a window whose end precedes its start crosses midnight. Omit `at` for now. Returns `inWindow` plus the matched window.

builtinTools.name: vector.search
builtinTools.description: Search the org's vector memory (workflow_vector kind) by semantic similarity.

inputExample.query: prior fixes for the billing webhook

builtinTools.name: vector.upsert
builtinTools.description: Store one entry in the org's vector memory (workflow_vector kind). Consent-gated.

inputExample.content: retries with backoff fixed the timeout

builtinTools.name: webhook.send
builtinTools.description: POST a signed JSON payload to an external URL with an HMAC-SHA256 signature header.

primitives.notes: One to 16 agents with explicit goals; sequential or parallel; bounded to 50 steps per member.
Exact saved workflow from subworkflows catalog.
Exactly one ISO-8601 duration or timezone-qualified instant.
